nodes.label: MediaPipe Analyzer Misnomer
nodes.rationale: The module is named 'MediaPipe Pose' but actually uses FaceLandmarker (468 face landmarks), not PoseLandmarker (33 body keypoints). No full-body skeletal tracking or hand landmark detection is implemented. The naming is misleading.

nodes.label: Moondream VLM Incompatibility
nodes.rationale: Moondream VLM uses GGUF format which is incompatible with the transformers library. This renders phone detection, cheat sheet detection, and unauthorized items detection non-functional as they depend on VLM analysis.

nodes.label: Single Camera Limitation
nodes.rationale: Pipeline is hardcoded to camera_id=0. Multi-camera support requires significant refactoring of CameraManager and the pipeline architecture.

nodes.label: Synchronous DB Writes Design Decision
nodes.rationale: EventLogger writes synchronously using get_db_session(), which blocks the pipeline during DB writes. Acceptable for MVP throughput but limits scalability. Uses SQLite StaticPool (single connection) which is thread-safe but not concurrent.

nodes.label: Missing Authentication
nodes.rationale: No authentication middleware exists. WebSocket URL has hardcoded ?token=demo. Anyone can access the API and manage exams. This is a HIGH severity limitation.

nodes.label: Missing Phone/Object Detection
nodes.rationale: YOLOv8 only detects persons (COCO class 0). No phone, book, or hand detection. AnomalyDetector has phone/cheat sheet rules but they depend on VLM analysis which is non-functional. Custom YOLO training or multi-class model needed.

nodes.label: Temporal Smoothing Pattern
nodes.rationale: AnomalyDetector uses consecutive_frames counting and 30-second cooldown per rule per track to prevent alert spam. Repeated violations escalate severity from MEDIUM to HIGH to CRITICAL.

nodes.label: YOLOv8 Auto-Download Design
nodes.rationale: YOLOv8 weights auto-download on first run via ultralytics library. Model stored locally at models/yolov8n.pt. Nano variant chosen for speed over accuracy trade-off.
